Double Dipper Thermo Wood Tubs

Your backyard sanctuary. Handcrafted, heat treated, and built to transform the way you unwind.

Two person tub

Built for two, made to order

A two person thermo wood tub, built to the same spec and finish as your sauna. How it runs is up to you.

Two person Timber built Wood or electric Made to order

One tub, two ways to run it

Choose a wood fired build for a hot soak, or the hot and cold build that heats to 40°C and chills to 3°C in the same tub.

The tub, timber, steps and thermo lid are the same in both. The heating is what sets them apart.

Choose how yours is built

Two builds, one tub

The difference is the heating. Everything else carries across both.

Wood fired

Wood Fired

A wood burner, integrated or external, heats the tub for a hot soak. Simple, off grid, no electricity needed to run it.

Heats for a hot soak
  • Thermowood Double Dipper tub
  • Timber steps
  • Insulated thermo lid
  • Wood burner of your choice, integrated or external
Hot and cold

Hot & Cold

An integrated electric unit heats to 40°C or chills to 3°C. One tub that works as a warm soak and a cold plunge, so you can move between the two.

Heats to 40°C Chills to 3°C
  • Thermowood Double Dipper tub
  • Timber steps
  • Insulated thermo lid
  • Electric heater and chiller unit, heat to 40°C or chill to 3°C

Not sure which suits you? Ask the team and we will talk it through.

Every Double Dipper is fully customisable

Choose your fibreglass insert colour and your timber stain to make it entirely your own.

White

Clean, bright, and timeless. The classic spa finish.

Graphite Grey

Sleek and understated. Our most popular finish.

Navy Blue

Bold and distinctive. A striking contrast to the natural wood.

Insert colour. Choose from White, Graphite Grey, or Navy Blue, or specify your own colour at the time of order.

Exterior finish. Our ThermoWood cladding can be stained to a colour of your choosing, or treated with an additional paraffin oil finish for a natural, protected look. Just let us know.

Thermo lid, included as standard

Hot water, lower bills

Every Double Dipper comes with a high quality insulated thermo lid, keeping your water hot, your energy bills low, and your tub protected year round.

Heat Retention

Thick insulated foam core locks in heat between sessions, so your tub is ready when you are.

Energy Efficient

Dramatically reduces heat loss, cutting the time and fuel needed to reheat.

Weather Protection

Shields the water and interior from rain, debris, and UV year round.

Included as Standard

No extras, no add ons. Every Double Dipper ships with the thermo lid included.

Evening ambience

Transforms after dark

Blue LED lighting glows through the water, steam rises into the night air, and the world outside disappears.

White Insert Recommended

The bright white fibreglass interior reflects the LED light beautifully, amplifying the glow.

Colour Changing LEDs

Vivid underwater LEDs create a calm, spa like atmosphere.

Heater options

Medium Round External Heater

  • Wood fired, no electricity required

  • Chimney: 1.4 m
